'''Jagleo''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who worked as a dancer before becoming a member of the [[White Worms]] gang on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. She worked as a [[thief]] for the gang and fought using a self-invented style of martial arts that made use of her balance and coordination. In [[13 BBY]], she was present when the [[scrumrat]] [[Han Solo|Han]] escaped from [[Proxima]] in the [[Den of the White Worms]].

==Biography==
Jagleo was [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] who worked as a dancer before becoming a [[scrumrat]] and a [[thief]] in the [[White Worms]] gang of [[Coronet City]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' that take place on [[Corellia]] to six years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events on Corellia in ''Solo'' must take place in [[13 BBY]].</ref> Jagleo was present in the den when fellow scrumrat [[Han Solo|Han]] was brought before [[Lady]] [[Proxima]], leader of the gang. Han, who had returned from a trade with no goods for Proxima, used a rock to break a shutter behind the gang leader and bathe her in light, which burned her skin. Using the distraction, Han then pushed through the other scrumrats and escaped.<ref name="Solo" />

After Solo's escape and Qi'ra's demotion and punishment, Jagleo found the injured girl in the barracks and talked to her about the future of the White Worms. She was worried that Proxima was planning on creating a situation that would get rid of the older scrumrats. Jagleo gave Qi'ra a thin jacket to replaced the one taken from her and the leftovers from a small [[ration pack]]. The thief realized that allying with Qi'ra was the best way to survive.<ref name="Crimson Climb" />

==Personality and traits==
Jagleo adapted her balance and coordination into a self-invented form of martial arts which she used to defend herself. She was a nimble thief and could shimmy into tight spaces.<ref name="SoloOG" /> She had fair skin, [[Color|blonde]] [[hair]], and green [[eye]]s.<ref name="Solo" />

==Equipment==
Jagleo wore a gray [[Salt|brine]]-stained [[Clothing|tunic]], wristwraps, and [[Hat|cap]] with a gray light-filter headband. She used a pipe as a makeshift weapon.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jagleo first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> The character was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
